excerpts.label: final
excerpts.text:
I opened PR #2 for issue #1, which replaces the placeholder with v1 of the site. `npm run validate` passes, and I looked at all four screenshots. At 1440px and 375px I also checked cropped views of the hero and workflow. There is no horizontal scroll at either width.

- **Look:** a graph-paper grid, serif headlines, monospace readouts and a rust accent, in light and dark. It follows the OS setting and has a toggle.
- **Counters:** spend, tokens, agent runs, PRs merged and days running come from `site/data/stats.json`. They count up, except under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Team:** cards use the copy in `how-it-works.json` plus live numbers from `stats.byRole`. Release shows deploy numbers…
